about: Release text for a request: the GitHub Release body (no trailing newline) and the latest.json notes and changes (changes only when not empty). The publisher's release-notes.jq and release-notes.mjs and the lane's whats-new.mjs body and feed must produce these bytes.

cases.name: a request without notes keeps the text every earlier release published
cases.release_body:
ZTC 0.11.0-beta.1 (preview).

Built from immutable Epoch-ML/zerg source commit `eedc94d57cd6224856beab9b16b5d6c235978ece`.

The updater archive is signed independently from the macOS application signature.

Bridge notice: ZTC-launched ZTC 0.1.2 sessions cannot complete this transition in-app. Install this release from the signed DMG once. Signed updates with session restoration are supported by this release; availability starts when the update feed is activated.

latest.notes: ZTC preview release from source eedc94d57cd6224856beab9b16b5d6c235978ece.

cases.name: highlights and changes

whats_new: Panes keep the name you give them.
changes: A renamed pane keeps its name in the desktop app.
Session resume no longer spends seconds before drawing.
ztc update installs a release published minutes earlier.

ZTC 0.12.0-beta.3 (preview).

Built from immutable Epoch-ML/zerg source commit `fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba98`.

- Backslash \ and "quotes" survive.
- Ellipsis is one character…
- Paths like ~/.ztc/config.json and #123 stay plain.
